author: The Q
description:
I used to think choosing a projector was easy. Just compare the specifications, pick the one with the biggest numbers, and you're done.
After testing several projectors, I realized that's not how it works. Two projectors can advertise similar specifications but deliver completely different results in real life.
In this video I compare brightness, ANSI lumens, autofocus speed, image quality, and the overall Roku TV experience to find out which specifications actually matter and which ones are just marketing.
